name: Suspicious Crispy Spring Rolls
desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. The crust was supposed to be crisp, but somehow it ended up soft and soggy — how strange... Wait, could this be the oil paper used to wrap the food...?

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 165 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
